name: CaseAntdEmptyMarginOnlyParts
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-empty-margin-only-parts" (geometry). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: span.c > span.a(empty) + span.b(empty) — two EMPTY inline-block spans whose only facts are margin-inline-start/end (antd Switch inner-checked / inner-unchecked)
